messages:
Sam: handing off after a noisy evening — quick summary below, taking questions.
Sam: Sev2 incident 20m ago: reranker service in eu-west started returning 429s and p95 token latency jumped x3. Customers affected: DataSync (enterprise), Atlas (trial org). No data loss reported, but requests throttled.
Sam: what happened: an autoscaler policy misapplied during a deployment so the reranker pool scaled down to 2 nodes while traffic spiked. KV cache hit-rate dropped and we saw hot prefix evictions causing backend stall.
OpsBot: INCIDENT ALERT auto-page: reranker-eu-west high 429-rate (alert id: INC-2026-0479) — severity: elevated.
Sam: immediate mitigations I ran: scaled reranker pool to 12 nodes, pinned traffic away from eu-west for non-local customers, applied model-fallback to reranker-small for non-enterprise, disabled batched requests at the gateway for the hot route to reduce tail latency.
Sam: commands used: ```
# scale pool
redwood infra scale --pool reranker-eu-west --replicas 12
# apply routing rule
redwood routes update --name rerank-fallback --match "org != DataSync" --route reranker-small-eu
```
Lina: taking primary for the next shift, ack. Thanks for the notes Sam — do we need to purge KV or warm any caches?
Sam: did a targeted evict on the problematic prefixes, not a full flush: ```
redis-cli -h kv-eu --eval evict_prefix.lua rerank:hot_prefix
``` That let workers rebuild hot entries gradually. Full flush would be risky for a live customer.
Diego: CS update: DataSync got one short degraded window; CS already messaged them and offered a postmortem. Atlas saw higher latency on embed->rerank path but no API errors.
Maya: any change to retry/backoff config? We turned down gateway retries to avoid amplifying load. Config patched: `gateway.retries=1` for route /v1/rerank.
Ben: do we know if the autoscaler rule will be fixed before next deploy? We should avoid a repeat.
Sam: yes opened infra ticket INFRA-289 to audit autoscaler policy and add an override that prevents scale-to-2 for production pools. Owner: @Diego (infra). ETA EOD.
Lina: runbook link? want the quick checklist.
Sam: runbook: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/reranker-429 — follow the "scale first, evict targeted prefixes, apply fallback" steps. Also check grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood/infra/d/reranker-eu-west
OpsBot: alert INC-2026-0479 status: mitigated -> stable. Auto-note: page closed by Sam.
Lina: got it. I'll monitor 30m, keep gateway routing pinned. If 429s > 2% for 5m -> escalate to oncall-sre.
Diego: confirming INFRA-289 assigned, I'll start the autoscaler policy postmortem and add unit tests for edge conditions.
Maya: I'll follow up with SRE to run a short canary for routing changes tomorrow morning (eu-west 10% traffic ramp).
Sam: remaining action items: 1) infra audit (INFRA-289) owner Diego, 2) update runbook with targeted-evict command and safe rollback, owner Sam, 3) CS post-incident note (DataSync), owner Diego/Ben.
Lina: note for incoming oncall: primary=Lina, secondary=Ben for next 8h. Coverage gap: overnight EU morning 02:00-05:00 UTC is light on bench; coordinate with infra to ensure warm pools.
Ben: acknowledged, will be secondary and on standby for escalate.
Sam: handing off logs snippet for quick glance: ```
[2026-03-15T19:02:11Z] reranker-eu pod-3 429 rate 0.28
[2026-03-15T19:03:05Z] autoscaler: scaled_to 2 replicas (trigger: deploy-hook)
[2026-03-15T19:04:40Z] kv-eu eviction: prefix rerank:hot_prefix evicted
[2026-03-15T19:06:20Z] reranker-eu pod list -> scaled to 12 replicas
```
Lina: thanks. I'll leave a short note in the morning channel if anything re-surfaces.
Sam: nice handoff — from my side: monitor token p95, 429 rate, and KV hit-rate. Revert routing fallback only after 30m stable at p95 baseline.
OpsBot: HANDOFF logged: from Sam to Lina (thread id 7209998888).
Lina: closing thread for now, will reopen if any degradation. :white_check_mark:
